description: This file defines the `BasicWorkSchedule` class, which implements scheduling-related functionalities for employee work shifts within the OrangeHRM system, including fetching shift times, checking for non-working days, holidays, and half-days.

classes.name: BasicWorkSchedule
classes.description: Implements work schedule functionalities such as retrieving shift times, checking non-working days, and holidays for employees in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getWorkShiftService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the WorkShiftService instance.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number currently set in the schedule.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for which the schedule is being computed.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of the employee's work shift, defaulting to system configuration if not specified.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Returns the start and end times of the work shift for the employee.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a non-working day according to the work week schedule.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is marked as a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
